qualitative_activity_context.summary: Results state that purified bacteriocin was active against the same strains tested in the plate-diffusion assay, but the local source does not provide separate purified-bacteriocin row-level zone or MIC values.
qualitative_activity_context.curation_action: Recorded as qualitative context only; not promoted to exact rows.

qualitative_activity_context.summary: Table 2 reports retained inhibitory activity (+) after heat, pH, and protease treatments using S. suis MGGUS3 as indicator strain.
qualitative_activity_context.curation_action: Preserved as qualitative stability context because + is not a numeric activity value.

qualitative_activity_context.summary: A 24 h culture supernatant lacked antibacterial activity, while solid-medium growth yielded bacteriocin-rich material for purification.

caution_findings.note: Table 1 numeric rows are inhibition-zone diameters from S. suis 65 producer-strain spots; the paper does not report suicin 65 MIC/MBC values.
No mammalian cytotoxicity or hemolysis assay is reported in the local article/package; no toxicity value was fabricated.
